description: The root of one subject's profile. Every fact hangs from it by a has-fact edge. Construct is its only writer and changes it on every write, so its version counter equals graph storage's stored node version and serves as the profile's compare-and-set. `removals` lists the facts the last writes removed whose soft delete may not have run yet; readers treat them as removed.

subject_id.description: The subject the profile belongs to, a platform user id.

version.description: The profile version: 1 when the root is created, one more on every write.

removals.description: Node keys of removed facts whose soft delete may still be pending.
